note: Scripture is spliced byte-for-byte from Kulish (1905), parsed whole from the ebible mirror (ukr_pan); each row was checked mechanically as a verbatim substring of its Kulish verse and present in the bio.
1 Timothy 6:8: the English quotes only “having food and raiment” and paraphrases the rest; the whole Kulish verse is quoted since the English sentence carries its full sense.
“As dry as Gilboa” is Evans’s own phrase alluding to 2 Samuel 1:21, not a quotation, so it is rendered in modern prose (Kulish has «гори Гелвуйські»).
